title: Office -> PDF -> unified parse (Word/Excel/PowerPoint reuse the existing PDF parser)
status_reason: Converter, router routing and unit tests are complete and passing. Real end-to-end LibreOffice conversion is NOT_RUN because no soffice/libreoffice binary is installed on this machine; those paths are covered only by @pytest.mark.integration tests that skip.

implemented: New module openviking/parse/office_converter.py: OfficeConverter converts .doc/.docx/.xls/.xlsx/.ppt/.pptx to PDF via an isolated LibreOffice headless invocation (_run_libreoffice seam).

Isolation/hardening: per-run throw-away user profile dir (-env:UserInstallation), --headless/--norestore/--nolockcheck/--nodefault/--nofilemru, wall-clock timeout, best-effort POSIX rlimits (RLIMIT_CPU/AS/FSIZE), pinned export filters per document kind, macros always disabled.

Per-kind export filters: Word exports heading bookmarks; Excel sets SinglePageSheets=false (no shrink-to-one-page) and exports sheet bookmarks; Impress exports per-slide bookmarks to preserve page order.

Clear, machine-readable conversion errors (OfficeConversionError.reason): missing_fonts, password_protected, corrupt, timeout, macro_blocked, unsupported_extension, resource_limit, conversion_failed, converter_unavailable. No AnyDoc->markdown fallback anywhere.

Pre-flight input inspection before invoking LibreOffice: OLE/CFB magic detection for encrypted OOXML and legacy EncryptionInfo/EncryptedPackage; zip validation for OOXML corruption; vbaProject.bin / macro marker detection; declared-font vs installed-font (fc-list) comparison; input size limit.

Excel/PPT structure provenance read back from the converted PDF (_read_pdf_structure: page_count, bookmark_count, bookmarks) so sheets/slides are locatable via the existing PDF parser's bookmark path.

TTL lifecycle: cleanup(result) removes the intermediate PDF/profile after the parse materializes; cleanup_expired() sweeps by mtime TTL; cleanup_source() optionally removes the original Office file (delete_source_after_parse), which is safe because persisted results never re-read the original.

parser_router.py: Office extensions are detected (resolved_extension aware) and routed through OfficeConverter -> existing PDF parser via the same ParserRegistry.parse path; structure_policy/parse_backend no longer rejected for Office (still rejected for non-PDF/non-Office). Conversion errors propagate; no AnyDoc fallback. Provenance merged into result.meta and result.source_format set to the Office extension.

structure_policy=bookmarks_preferred semantics delegated to the PDF parser: bookmarks tried first, automatic fallback to Markdown headings/rules when absent or unaligned; real errors (password/failed conversion/empty/truncation) still surface.

Excel formula execution semantics are explicitly out of scope; a warning is attached to Excel parse results.
